identification: Mixed lot: woven rattan tray, green faux-malachite painted metal oval planter, printed tin with woven-basket pattern and lid, and a part chandelier. Photos at full size (about 350 px wide, low resolution) show the chandelier is a gilt/bronzed tole grape-and-vine-leaf chandelier with bunches of gold grapes, a central stem and chain, a shell-shaped fluted cap at the bottom, and at least 2 visible candle arms with dished leaf bobeches (probably 3 arms, one hidden). Italian Florentine tole style, probably 1950s-60s, origin not proven. Looks complete in shape but untested, with loose wiring and no shades. The chandelier is the only item with real value.

viewing_check: Armitage estimate 40-60, current bid $10 (re-checked 9 Nov), 22% premium. Andy should check at the viewing: arm count, whether all leaves/grapes are present and not bent, rust or flaking gilt, wiring (needs rewiring and an electrician to be sold to be used), and the weight/size for posting. eBay sold prices for 3 to 5 arm grape tole chandeliers cluster A$145 to A$330, with complete or crystal-fitted ones up to A$580; poor auction examples go far lower (Brooks US$24 in 2021). Most prices are within 2 years (2024 to Oct 2026) and look flat; the 2021 and 2022 auction results are older. Most Terapeak sales are eBay US listings, so US buyers paid the price and postage; fragile and bulky to post from Tasmania. The other items in the lot (tray, planter, tin) are minor.
